artworks.title: Bust of the Virgin
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body. She is facing forward with her head tilted slightly to the left and her eyes closed. The woman has long hair, draped in a veil, and wears a flowing garment. Her hands are clasped together near her chest. A halo surrounds her head. In the background, there is a linear pattern. The text "MARIA MATER DEI" is displayed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Battle of Naked Men and Peasants
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a print of a battle scene in a forest, with men engaged in combat amidst a backdrop of dense trees. The men are a mix of armed and unarmed, some holding long swords, sticks, axes, or pitchforks. Some are lying on the ground. Some of the men are nude apart from small garments around their groins, while other men are wearing full outfits with tunics, jackets, and wide-brimmed hats. The background includes tall trees with heavy branches in front of a sky filled with thin, horizontal lines. In the bottom left and right corners of the paper, below the print, are small rectangles with text in them.

artworks.title: Après le Bain II (After the Bath II)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back to the viewer. The individual is bending over slightly, with their arms across their body. Their head is lowered, and their long, dark hair partially covers their face. The person appears nude in an undefined interior space. The background is textured, dark, and shadowy, with lighter tones hinting at obscured forms or objects. There are no visible accessories or objects, and the image is in monochrome.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Catherine, Saint John the Evangelist, and an Angel
artworks.medium: etching with stipple on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures depicted from the waist up in a seated position. In the center, a woman is cradling an infant. To her left is an individual with curly hair, and to her right is an older male figure with a beard. Another person behind them is holding a cup. The figures are surrounded by flowing drapery, with intricate patterns on their clothing.

artworks.title: The "Well," for Violators of State Law
artworks.artist: Giovanni  De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a dark, enclosed space. A flame casts light on the scene, creating harsh shadows. On the left, one figure is kneeling, holding a torch, showing intense emotion. On the right, another figure lies on the ground with a resigned look. The surroundings include a stairway and bare stone walls, creating an atmosphere of solitude and hardship.

artworks.title: The "Ovens," for Those Who Wouldn't Admit Their Crimes
artworks.artist: Giovanni De Pian, after Francesco Galimberti
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person lying curled up on their side inside a small, dark, arched stone enclosure. The individual appears to be resting their head on their hands. Their facial features are faintly lit by a small light source, revealing short, light-colored hair and a slightly upturned face. The person is wearing simple clothing - a long-sleeved garment and pants. Next to them, there is a wooden bucket on the ground. In the background, there is a dark stone wall.

artworks.title: Tête de Joseph (Head of Joseph)
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed from two plates in black and white on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchase as the Gift of Ivan and Winifred Phillips in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body view of a person. The individual is facing slightly to the left with their head tilted upwards. The person has fine facial features, long flowing hair, and is wearing a draped garment around the neck and shoulders. The background is plain and light-toned, contrasting with the darker shading used for the person.

artworks.title: Tête de Putiphar (Head of Potiphar's Wife)
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed from two plates in black and white on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchase as the Gift of Ivan and Winifred Phillips in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length section of a person from the upper chest up. The person is in a profile view, facing towards the right. Their facial features include a rounded nose, slightly open lips, and a defined jawline, with their gaze directed upwards. The hair is styled in an elaborate manner with curls and appears tied back. The person is draped in fabric that covers their shoulders, rendered in soft folds. The background consists of a textured pattern with diagonal lines.

artworks.title: Charlotte, Lady Watkin Williams-Wynn
artworks.medium: pastel with graphite and gouache on laid paper prepared with white ground
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a woman in an elegant pose, with her right elbow on a surface and her hand supporting her cheek with fingers curled around her face as she looks to the left. She has pale skin, rosy cheeks, pink lips, and brown hair styled on top of her head. She is wearing an elegant outfit with a gray fur-like trim over a light-colored fabric, and she has a decorative bracelet on her wrist with several strands of pearls. The background is dark with hints of blue on the left, suggesting a sky behind some blurred trees.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl Postmortem
artworks.medium: daguerreotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: This photograph shows a young child lying down on a cushioned surface. The child is on their side with their head on the left, resting on a cushion, their arms crossed over the torso. The child has closed eyes, pale skin, and smooth dark hair, and they are wearing a light-colored, short-sleeved tan dress with what looks like a bright orange necklace around their neck. The surface they lay on is a blend of brown and blue abstract shapes. The oval photograph is surrounded by an ornate golden frame with floral motifs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl Postmortem
artworks.medium: daguerreotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund

artworks.title: Young Shepherd on Horseback
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a shepherd riding a donkey surrounded by sheep. The horizon is visible through sketched foliage. The etching technique conveys textures like the wool of sheep and tree foliage. The color palette is monochromatic using shades of grey and black for depth. Sheep and donkey show detailed textures, while trees and foliage extend into a soft background.

artworks.title: Peasants with a Cart
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Museum of Mathematics Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people with a cart and dogs in a forested area. The drawing depicts a scene where a group is traveling, with some individuals walking alongside a large cart drawn by a horse. The cart carries a few people, and one person is standing on the cart, playing a wind instrument. The setting appears to be a forested area, with tall, bare trees and some coniferous trees in the background. The people are dressed in detailed, period attire. This image is done in a detailed and intricate line art style.

artworks.title: Five Tilters on Foot
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Museum of Mathematics Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures wearing armor and holding lances. The image depicts a group standing in a line, dressed in ornate armor with plumed helmets, each holding a long lance upright. The armor is intricately detailed, showing various textures and patterns. The figures stand on a lightly detailed ground with a sparse landscape. The paper shows signs of aging, with browned edges and slight creases.

artworks.title: Milan Cathedral
artworks.medium: gouache over lithograph on wove paper, on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image displays an aerial view of a cityscape with a Gothic cathedral in the center. The skyline features mountains and greenery surrounding the city. The painting shows soft, expressive clouds in a pale blue sky with hints of pink and lavender. The city buildings are depicted in warm earthy tones, contrasting with the cool whites and grays of the cathedral. People and carriages are visible on the streets at different distances.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy of Roman Ruins with an Inscription Plaque
artworks.artist: Rose Angélique Moitte, after Jean-Baptiste Lallemand
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image consists of a large decorative frame with historical script surrounded by architectural elements like tall columns, a bust of an ancient figure, and a tree curving above the frame. The artwork has a monochromatic palette in shades of gray with vegetation, ruins, fruit, leaves, and a mountain in the background.

artworks.title: A Monk Seated with Arms Outstretched [Study for the Virgin in the _Vision of Blessed Felice da Cantalice_]
artworks.medium: black, white and red chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure with their upper body turned slightly to the side, stretching out their arms forward. Their facial features are subtly shaded, and their hair appears styled close to the head. The individual wears a long, flowing garment with voluminous sleeves, indicated by rich folds and creases in the fabric. The hands are prominently depicted, with one palm facing upward and fingers slightly extended. No jewelry or objects are visible. The figure is resting on a cloud-like surface, and the background is a muted, earthy tone with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Head Study of a Young Man Looking Upward
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person's head and the top of their neck. The person is in a three-quarter view, looking upward and to the side. The facial features include a prominent jawline, full cheeks, a gently closed mouth, and softly squinting eyes. The hair is wavy, swept back with loose strands. The drawing is framed by a double-lined border. The background has a warm texture resembling aged paper, with no visible jewelry or objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Oyster Boats
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows several boats on a pebbled shore. There is an empty wooden rowboat in the foreground and a larger boat named "Waine Swainer" in the background. The horizon is blocked by rocky cliffs on the right side. The scene is monochrome and highlights textures and shapes such as the pebbles, boats, and cliffs. The overall mood is one of quiet resilience.

artworks.title: River Landscape near St. Ives, Huntingdonshire
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This painting depicts a marshy landscape with a reflective stream running through its center. Tall trees border the stream on the left, with more trees visible in the distance beyond a grassy meadow. On either side of the stream are tall yellow and green grasses. The sky above is light blue with wispy clouds, with some small birds flying overhead.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.medium: ambrotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl standing next to a table holding a doll. She has shoulder-length, dark curly hair and wears a light-colored, long-sleeved dress with dark shoes. The table has a vase with flowers and a patterned cloth. Behind her is a curtain with intricate designs.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: daguerreotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a formal posture with his left arm resting on an upholstered armrest. He gazes directly at the camera with a calm yet attentive expression. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a broad nose, and lips that are closed in a neutral line. His hair is short, slightly curled, and neatly styled. He is dressed in a suit comprising a dark jacket over a plaid vest and a white shirt underneath, complemented by a light-colored bow tie. He wears a ring on his left hand's pinky finger. The backdrop is plain, focusing attention on the subject within a case featuring a maroon and gold border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: daguerreotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a man inside an oval matte and enclosed by a rectangular frame. He stands with his shoulders slightly turned, facing the camera. His facial expression is confident and he has short, textured hair. He is dressed in formal attire, which includes a dark suit jacket, a patterned waistcoat, a white shirt, and a patterned cravat tied around his neck. One of his hands is resting on his hip. The background is a dark, neutral setting that puts the focus on the man without any visible details.

artworks.title: Young Woman Asleep
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman's upper body and head in profile. Her head is slightly tilted backward, with closed eyes and calm expression. She has curly hair around her face and is wearing a textured garment draped around her shoulders. There is a suggestion of a ribbon or bow near her neck. The background is composed of cross-hatched lines creating a shaded effect.
